The first step to build healthy lifelong habits
The built-in timer helps your child to brush for the recommended 2 minutes. With the QuadPacer's gentle pause in vibration every 30 seconds, they'll feel when it's right to move to a different part of their mouth.
A dash of joy in your child's bathroom space
Fun and easy to use, Philips One For Kids has a colorful handle that's lightweight and easy to grip. The playful stand lets your child enjoy their own space in the bathroom from an early age.
Specially designed to protect kids' teeth and gums
Our brush head's soft mini-bristles help protect tooth enamel and gums and the rubber backing feels gentler for little mouths. Don't forget to change the brush head every 3 months for best results!

features.name: SmarTimer and QuadPacer
features.description: The built-in timer helps your child to brush for the recommended 2 minutes. With the QuadPacer's gentle pause in vibration every 30 seconds, they'll feel when it's right to move to a different part of their mouth.

features.name: Colorful handle and fun stand
features.description: Fun and easy to use, Philips One For Kids has a colorful handle that's lightweight and easy to grip. The playful stand lets your child enjoy their own space in the bathroom from an early age.

features.name: Soft bristles and brush head
features.description: Our brush head's soft mini-bristles help protect tooth enamel and gums and the rubber backing feels gentler for little mouths. Don't forget to change the brush head every 3 months for best results!

features.name: Gentle micro-vibrations
features.description: Philips One For Kids uses gentle micro-vibrations to clean your child's teeth while they brush. It helps them to transition comfortably and smoothly from manual to electric brushing.

features.name: Long lasting battery
features.description: The Philips One For Kids provides 90 days of brushing from a single AAA battery. That's three months of gentle, comfortable brushing.

features.name: 21-day brushing diary
features.description: Did you know it takes 21 days to turn practice into a habit? It's true for your child's brushing, too. To help develop that good brushing routine, we've designed a fun and interactive 21-day brushing diary. Use it to keep your little learner engaged with their routine by marking off the moment every morning and evening. Or getting creative together with drawings, gold stars and stickers!
